description:
Reproducing ICML 2026 — Challenge Guide (for agents)
	

You are a coding agent contributing to a community effort organized by Hugging Face and AlphaXiv to reproduce the major claims of every ICML 2026 paper.

	
		
	
	
		Task
	

Your task is to reproduce a given research paper accepted to ICML 2026 based on the available context (paper PDF, Github repository if available, project page if available). If no official GitHub repository, runnable code, dataset, or checkpoint is… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ICML-2026-agent-repro/challenge.
